purpose: Define evidence, freshness, reopening, exception and signature semantics for ESS-1000 so essential completion is exact-head, non-compensable and revocable when reality changes.

signatures.separation_rule: implementation signer and independent verifier must be distinct identities for closure
signatures.finality_rule: ESS1000-1000 requires an additional whole-system finality verifier distinct from the implementation owner

invalidation_triggers: dependency or toolchain changes that affect behavior
configuration or policy changes that affect the essential
security vulnerability or incident affecting the essential
evidence artifact missing, corrupted or revoked
freshness.revalidation_rule: Any invalidation trigger moves the affected essential out of signed closure until required evidence is reproduced against the new exact identity.
freshness.dependency_propagation: Reopening an essential invalidates downstream ESS levels whose acceptance proof depends on it.

state_rules.open: No current implementation and closure evidence set exists.
state_rules.specified: Canonical minimum and contract are defined but implementation proof is incomplete.
state_rules.implementation_candidate: Implementation identity exists but the full stage evidence floor is not yet satisfied.
state_rules.evidence_incomplete: Implementation exists but one or more required evidence classes are missing, failed or inconclusive.
state_rules.verification_pending: Required implementation evidence passes but independent verification signature is missing.
state_rules.signed_current: All required evidence is current, signatures are separated and no invalidation trigger is active.
state_rules.stale: Evidence was once sufficient but a relevant identity/configuration/environment/dependency changed.
state_rules.regressed: Current evidence demonstrates failure of the essential.
state_rules.revoked: Evidence/signature was explicitly invalidated or found untrustworthy.
state_rules.blocked: Closure cannot proceed because a prerequisite essential or external required control is unresolved.

exception_policy.expiry_rule: Expired exceptions fail closed and reopen the essential gap.
exception_policy.production_rule: An exception may permit explicitly bounded operation under policy, but the ESS level remains incomplete until normal closure evidence exists.

applicability.optional_capability_rule: Optional functionality may be disabled, but the safe-disabled path remains subject to the essential's control obligations.
applicability.platform_control_rule: Platform-wide security, privacy, authority, recovery, evidence and human-control essentials are never erased by capability disablement.

finality.aggregate_rule: ESS-1000 finality exists only when every essential's latest derived state is signed_current and the whole-system reproduction is current.
